environment.description: Same Celery worker deployment on ECS Fargate. CloudFront distribution (ID: E2XYZABC123) sits in front of the job submission API with Origin Access Control (OAC) configured. The distribution has a custom cache behavior for /api/resize/* with a Lambda@Edge viewer-request function (ARN: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:resize-param-validator:7) that inspects the request body JSON, computes width*height*channels using Python arbitrary-precision integers, and rejects any request where the product exceeds 2^31-1 bytes (returns 403). The origin (ALB) has security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f that only allows inbound from CloudFront managed prefix list (pl-3b927c52). Direct origin access is blocked; only requests passing through the CloudFront distribution with valid Ed25519 signed URLs (key group kg-resize-prod) reach the ALB. The Lambda@Edge function was deployed via SAM template with the validation logic hash sha256:a8f9c2d1e..., and CloudFront access logs confirm 100% of /api/resize requests transit through the edge function.

config.origin_access: OAC with ALB origin, sg allows only CloudFront prefix list pl-3b927c52
